Game Overview

The Entity puts players into a horror experience centered on quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

The moment-to-moment gameplay in The Entity is easy to pick up. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is The Entity?

The Entity is a free horror game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is The Entity free to play?

Yes, The Entity is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
